We don’t get good rips all the time, but he’s still an animated cartoon mouse who needs his features, and he’s someone with iconic expressions. That’s why I wanted his face to move. I wasn’t randomly complaining about nothing for no reason. There was an actual reason behind my frustration, and instead of rigging the mesh properly, creators just left it blank.
At this point, I’m not even asking for a custom-made rig anymore because apparently that’s too much. I’m asking for one basic standard. Make the eyes work. Make the mouth open.
